paper_reference: Asai et al., SELF-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection, ICLR 2024.
installation_command: git clone https://github.com/AkariAsai/self-rag.git external/self-rag && git -C external/self-rag checkout 1fcdc420e48f50a7d7ab1ece5494221b93252e99 && python -m venv external/envs/self-rag && external/envs/self-rag/bin/pip install -r external/self-rag/requirements.txt
isolation: Use a dedicated virtual environment under external/envs/self-rag or a container; do not install Self-RAG dependencies into the project test environment.
model_retriever_requirements: Official Self-RAG model or compatible checkpoints downloaded outside Git.
Retriever/index resources required by the official release.
A JSON-stdin runner wrapper that calls the official Self-RAG code at the pinned commit.

expected_output_mapping.stdin: JSON object with baseline_id, comparison_mode, session_id, query, target_time, evidence, budgets, and native_config.
expected_output_mapping.stdout: JSON object. Required: answer or final_answer. Optional: predicted_state/state, confidence, predicted_hypothesis_id, citation_supported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd.
expected_output_mapping.answer: PredictionRecord.answer is stored in metadata.native_execution.raw_output and evaluated externally.
expected_output_mapping.state: Native state is recorded only when emitted by the runner. Otherwise predicted_state remains null and state_source is unsupported.
expected_output_mapping.citations: Runner must keep any citation support tied to exact provided evidence chunks in controlled mode.

readiness_notes: The official repository does not provide this repo's JSON-stdin contract. Configure runner_command to a local wrapper inside the pinned Self-RAG checkout. The wrapper must not download model weights during tests.

state_support.abstain: native only if the wrapper maps official Self-RAG critique/no-support behavior to abstain
state_support.unknown: evaluator_derived when no native state is emitted
